protocol.purpose: Isolate explicit-bound frame metadata bypass equally for standard CPU, Torch CPU and CUDA; full executable wall time is decisive.
protocol.qualification: Six fresh processes before any measurements; exact published scheme-specific conditioned strain and PSD files/data, candidate science equal to its contemporaneous same-scheme baseline, unchanged strict trigger comparator, plus bitwise same-scheme scientific H1 datasets. Only four H1/search performance telemetry paths are excluded from bitwise scientific equality; their performance metrics are independently verified by timing controls.
protocol.qualification_comparisons: Each candidate against own baseline, plus all five non-reference roles against standard-baseline; eight comparison reports total.
protocol.timing: Three fresh processes per role, in forward/reverse/forward role order; each of 18 runs compared against standard-baseline qualification and own-role qualification. All same-scheme comparisons additionally bitwise exact.
protocol.workload: Inherited executable-v3 config and input pins: 384 compressed BNS/NSBH templates, five segments, 1,920 scalar 2M IFFTs, 1,904 valid detector seconds; no geometry or tolerance changes.
protocol.runtime: One serial campaign under shared benchmark lock on len CPU8 with SMT sibling72; native and Torch intra/inter-op pools one, inherited clean environment and runtime/source/native/input/helper pins before and after workers. Shared-host result, not an empty-machine or all-core saturation claim.
protocol.launch: Fresh controller session with PID=PGID, recorded start ticks and logs. Whole-group timeout/stop. Require whole-group absence and nonblocking lock reacquisition audit after native tests and qualification before the next phase.
protocol.report: Report full executable wall, internal search wall, setup wall, and both full-wall and stored internal templates-per-core medians/ranges with paired ratios. Compare candidate Torch CPU and CUDA against standard-candidate as well as their own baselines. Preserve all raw evidence and earlier v3 results. No integration, PR, push or docs publication.

clearance: Frozen six-role qualification may run. Timing requires all six qualifications and eight trigger comparisons, exact per-scheme strain/PSD/trigger gates, and matched terminal audit. Timing claims await 18 fresh processes and independent receipt/science/result replay.
review_scope: Full controller delta read against reviewed v3; all eight inherited helpers and input/science references byte-identical.
All source/native/input/lock/runtime controls retained; new native prerequisite audited and hashed in immutable manifest.
Same-scheme recursive H1 gate: 17 controls passed using actual extracted code and previous real HDF files.
Contemporaneous standard candidate added; six qualifications plus 18 timings, serial forward/reverse/forward.
Native timeout 300s and executable worker timeout 3600s terminate whole process group. Launch must retain fresh session PID=PGID and inherited lock.
limitations: This report covers harness and native validation, not full-executable performance.
Remote source/input controls require actual run receipts; earlier failed campaigns remain preserved.
